summary: Iteration 2 frontend verification of portfolio refinement. 50/51 acceptance checks PASS. The lone 'fail' was a test artifact (initial scrollY read at 0 before scroll settled). Stability sentinel persisted across 15s idle and final scrollY was 1500 — confirming NO auto-reload/remount. All iteration-2 deltas verified: maroon blazer profile photo wired everywhere (navbar, hero, about, footer, mobile sheet), Cumulative GPA 3.98 is first hero stat, journey starts with 2022 Musabaqah then 2022 Movie then 2024 IS Program, Revoist/Fasilkom/ISGATH/HIMSIKA-PR/HSU/EduFair journey + experience cards render their images, Achievements has NO Academic/GPA card but retains PKM-PM and Business Plan, FinConnect subtitle = 'AI Powered FinTech Platform' on both the home featured slide and /case-study/finconnect with all 6 listed features, no em dashes on home or FinConnect case study, theme toggle flips html class dark<->light, footer copyright centered with no 'Crafted with' line, mobile (390x844) has no horizontal overflow and the mobile sheet shows the maroon photo + name + role.

tests_executed.stability_no_auto_reload: PASS — window.__sentinel set before 15s idle was still defined after; scroll moved from 0->1500 and stayed at 1500 (no reset, no remount)
tests_executed.profile_image_global: PASS — profile-maroon.png referenced identically by navbar-logo, hero-portrait, about-section, footer brand, and mobile-nav-overlay
tests_executed.hero_stats: PASS — 4 cards in order: Cumulative GPA, Flagship Projects, Certifications, National Awards
tests_executed.journey_order_and_images: PASS — 12 entries with first three = (2022 Musabaqah, 2022 Modernization, 2024 IS Program). Image banners render on Revoist/Fasilkom/ISGATH (2025), HIMSIKA PR/HSU/EduFair (2026)
tests_executed.experiences_section: PASS — 8 cards, all required roles present, images render for HIMSIKA-PR, Revoist, Fasilkom Cup, ISGATH
tests_executed.achievements_section: PASS — no Academic Achievement / GPA 3.98 card; PKM-PM and Business Plan awards present
tests_executed.finconnect_repositioning: PASS — '/case-study/finconnect' shows subtitle 'AI Powered FinTech Platform' (old copy absent) and lists all 6 features
tests_executed.em_dash_audit: PASS — 0 em dashes in body of home or finconnect case study (the matches in source are inside JSX comments only)
tests_executed.theme_toggle: PASS — clicking [data-testid='theme-toggle'] flips html class dark<->light
tests_executed.footer: PASS — centered '© 2026 Nur Azhim Ramadhan. All rights reserved.' with profile-maroon brand image; no 'Crafted with React · Tailwind · Framer Motion' line
tests_executed.mobile_nav: PASS — no horizontal overflow at 390x844; hamburger opens overlay with maroon profile photo + name + role + nav items

critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking: ThemeContext memoization (useMemo/useCallback) confirmed in iteration-1 carryover — keeps re-renders stable.

Minor: in /app/frontend/src/components/Journey.jsx the items list inside .map uses array index as key (key={i}). Acceptable here (list is static), but switching to a stable label slug would be cleaner.
Minor: Footer brand image uses loading='lazy' — fine for footer but profile photo will pop in late on first paint on slow networks. Consider 'eager' for the navbar instance (already eager in hero).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (50/51 checks; 1 false-positive due to scrollY race in test harness, root cause verified non-functional)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-2 deltas verified end-to-end: new maroon-blazer profile.png is the global profile image; journey starts with 2022 Musabaqah; per-event journey/experience cards render uploaded images (himsika-pr, revoist, fasilkom, isgath, hsu, edufair); FinConnect repositioned as 'AI Powered FinTech Platform' with 6 features; Academic GPA card removed from Achievements (GPA still shown in Hero stat + About card); theme toggle and background grid work in both modes. data-testid coverage remains excellent. No auto-refresh/remount observed during 15s idle. If a future iteration changes the journey ordering, update the first-three assertion in this test.
